## HOSPITALIST PROGRESS NOTE - HD#5
Date: 10/06/2026 07:40
S: Cough much improved, less sputum. No dyspnea walking in hall. Eating well.
O: T 98.4F HR 82 BP 122/74 RR 16 SpO2 95% RA. Few RLL crackles. AOx4.
Afebrile since 10/03 18:00. WBC 14.8 -> 8.9.
A/P:
1. CAP RLL - clinically improved. IV ceftriaxone/azithromycin STOPPED 10/04; transitioned to PO amoxicillin-clavulanate 875 mg BID through 10/09. Azithromycin course completed 10/05. No IV antibiotics needed. PIV removed 10/05.
2. Hypoxemia - resolved. On room air since 10/04, ambulatory SpO2 95% RA. No home O2 needed.
3. Isolation - respiratory viral panel negative 10/02; droplet precautions discontinued 10/02. No isolation.
4. Dispo - medically stable for d/c to recuperative care today. PCP f/u and repeat CXR in 6 wks.
Signed: Patience Okonkwo, MD
